description: Low-bandwidth performance budgets and constrained network/CPU profile. Single source of truth shared by measurement tooling and reviewers. Grounded in HLD section 11.5.

budgets.note: Largest Contentful Paint for content-first pages (landing + category), measured at the 75th percentile of real-user / lab runs on the constrained profile.
Time To Interactive for interaction-heavy funnel pages (product, cart, checkout), measured at the 75th percentile.

api.note: For 95% of API interactions a first response must be shown within 2s and the interaction must fully complete within 5s.

profile.name: constrained-low-bandwidth
profile.description: Reusable throttling profile approximating a low-end mobile device on a regular-3G-class link. Apply directly in Lighthouse / WebPageTest / Playwright CDP throttling so lab measurements share one definition.

cpu.note: 4x slowdown relative to a reference desktop CPU, representative of a low-end mobile SoC.
